label: id
comment: A unique identifier (URI) assigned to the product passport. May be a UUID
The globally unique ID of the facility as URI, ideally as a resolvable URL.
A unique identifier for the declaration. Often this will be an extension of the product.id or attestation.id. But could be a UUID.

domainIncludes.comment: A digital verifiable credential holding facility performance information.
The physical site (eg farm or factory) where the product or materials was produced. Including the facility sustainability performance record.
A conformity claim about the facility against a specific standard or regulation.
